SELF-INITIATED STUDY / LIVING

The Sun Room

A gathering space, softened.

Brief: A small living room with one generous window.

Role: spatial concept and original illustration. Outcome: a visual proposal, not a measured built result.

Read the project story +

Constraints & concept: Move seating away from the window and preserve a direct route through the room.

Material direction: Warm plaster, oak-toned surfaces and linen-inspired upholstery. Supplier products and permissions have not been supplied.

Plans are conceptual and not to scale. A qualified local professional must verify dimensions, building rules and individual access needs. No completed photographs are available.

BEFORE & AFTER / SUN ROOM PLAN STUDY

A little more
room to move.

Both drawings share the same room outline. The initial arrangement interrupts the central route; the proposal moves seating toward the wall and keeps the window zone open.

Circulation: fewer furniture conflicts. Light: the window stays visually clear. Storage: a lower unit replaces the central block. Accessibility: a clearer route is an intention, not a certified clearance or access assessment.

A CONSIDERED WAY OF WORKING

Listen first.
Make space for what matters.

Mara Vale is an illustrative identity, specializing here in warm, practical residential concepts. No biography, formal credentials or professional location was supplied.

The working approach is simple: understand daily routines, test the layout, develop a material language, then document the choices. Every room image on this page is an original vector drawing, not photography of a built space.
